direct_answer:
Yes. Vopak states that it has a climate change mitigation transition plan: “Our transition plan is integral to our business strategy and daily operations” and is embedded in budgeting and investment decision-making [Source 1]. Vopak also describes an “environmental transition plan” with a goal of “achieving net-zero by 2050” and a 2030 interim target to “reduce Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 30% from our 2021 baseline” [Source 4].

The retrieved passages do not support that the transition plan is aligned with limiting global warming to 1.5°C. Vopak explicitly notes that its “current GHG reduction goals do not fully align with the IPCC's 1.5 ℃ warming scenario” because it “hasn't set a Scope 3 reduction target” [Source 5]. Vopak also indicates it is refining its transition plan, including developing a Scope 3 emissions reduction target, and will “actively evaluate the ambition” of its current target given “current nonalignment with IPCC scenarios” [Source 10].

Because a transition plan exists, a timeline for adopting one is not applicable based on the retrieved passages [Source 1][Source 4].
compliance_rationale: Evidence confirms the existence of a transition plan and provides high-level integration into strategy/financial planning and key targets (net-zero 2050; Scope 1&2 -30% by 2030) [Source 1][Source 4]. However, the company states its goals do not fully align with a 1.5°C scenario due to lack of a Scope 3 reduction target, and the passages do not provide a 1.5°C compatibility explanation or science-based methodology details required to substantiate alignment [Source 5][Source 10].
disclosure_gaps: Explicit explanation of how the transition plan and GHG targets are compatible with limiting warming to 1.5°C (as required by ESRS E1-1.16(a)); retrieved passages instead indicate non-alignment [Source 5].

Disclosure of whether and how targets are science-based and compatible with 1.5°C, including the framework/methodology used, underlying climate/policy scenarios for target-setting, and whether targets have been externally assured (ESRS E1-4.34(e)); not evidenced in retrieved passages [Source 4][Source 5][Source 10].

Scope 3 GHG emission reduction target (Vopak states it has not set one yet) and how/when it will be set; only an intention to refine actions/plan including a Scope 3 target is provided [Source 5][Source 10].
Quantified financial resources for implementing the transition plan (Vopak says it is not yet equipped to provide precise financial details) [Source 6].
key_findings: Vopak reports having a transition plan embedded in business strategy, budgeting, and investment decision-making [Source 1].
Vopak’s environmental transition plan includes net-zero by 2050 and a 2030 target of -30% Scope 1 and 2 emissions vs. 2021 baseline for operationally controlled assets [Source 4].
Vopak states its current GHG reduction goals do not fully align with the IPCC 1.5°C scenario because it has not set a Scope 3 reduction target [Source 5].

Vopak is refining its transition plan and actions, including developing a Scope 3 emissions reduction target, and will evaluate the ambition of its current target due to nonalignment with IPCC scenarios [Source 10].
